name: Berggasthaus Hermine
beschreibung: The Berggasthaus Hermine is run as a youth hostel in the municipality of Zams. The facility is located in the district of Landeck at the entrance to the Kaunertal. The accommodation has multi-bed rooms and common rooms. A lounge with a kitchenette is available to guests for self-catering. The location makes hiking possible in summer and skiing in winter at the Venet. Meals can be added on request. The youth hostel is suitable for groups, families, and independent travelers.
